author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: clk_fast/clk_slow are declared -physically_exclusive and the contract says only one runs. hand_q->cap_q is a single-flop Exclusive crossing: CDC-003/CDC-028 INFO; CDC-037(a) needs a depth >= 2 chain and does not trigger; CDC-013 is exempt for Exclusive. slow_rst_ni is synchronous and contracted; outputs are Same.

author_reading.rationale: clk_fast and clk_slow are declared physically exclusive; a single-register handoff between mutually exclusive clocks never runs concurrently, so a depth-1 handoff is the intended structure.

labels.rationale: The board contract and SDC agree on physical exclusivity. The single-stage capture does not form a contradictory synchronizer, and its synchronous reset and output are timed to clk_slow.

clk_fast and clk_slow are declared physically exclusive in intent.sdc:4, and the single-stage capture from hand_q (clk_fast) to cap_q (clk_slow) has no redundant synchronizer (so CDC-037 does not fire and CDC-003 emits only INFO with the exclusive-clock trust model). All ports including synchronous reset slow_rst_ni carry valid input/output delay contracts.
